details.description: Nova 2 Lite is Amazon's cost-efficient multimodal model in the Nova 2 family, launched December 2, 2025 for high-volume automation, document processing and customer support across text and image input. It introduces optional extended thinking with three selectable reasoning-effort levels, a 1-million-token context window, up to 64K output tokens, and built-in web-grounding and code-interpreter tools for agentic workflows.
advantages: Supports extended thinking with three selectable reasoning-effort levels (low, medium, high) for multi-step, coding and STEM reasoning tasks (AWS Amazon Nova 2 user guide).
Processes text and image input with a 1-million-token context window and up to 64K output tokens (AWS Bedrock model card).
Includes built-in web-grounding and code-interpreter tools usable without external integrations (AWS Amazon Nova 2 user guide).
Supports supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning on Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker AI (AWS Amazon Nova 2 user guide).
disadvantages: Output is text only; the model cannot generate image, video or audio (AWS Bedrock model card).

When extended thinking is enabled, the reasoning content is returned as '[REDACTED]' rather than shown to the caller, though reasoning tokens are still billed as output tokens (AWS Amazon Nova 2 user guide).
